title: finding(changeset): a pending changeset says the spec-symbol gate skips non-exported declarations — objectui#6291 made that false, and it publishes verbatim
body:
Found by the `os-dev` seat implementing the `@object-ui/data-objectstack` slice of objectui#7265 (PR objectui#9527), surfaced by `check:changeset-claims` asking it to read the four pending changesets that name the gate file. ⛔ Not repaired there: it is another card's pending body.

## The defect

`.changeset/6286-explain-batch-cap-from-spec.md` is **pending** — it has not been released, so it will publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release — and it says of `scripts/check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs` that **"both of its scanners skip non-exported declarations"**.

That is **false today**. objectui#6291 widened **rule 1** to see **module-local** declarations, and that widening is the only reason objectui#7265's whole burn-down exists: every name in that block is a module-local mirror rule 1 could not previously see.

⇒ a released CHANGELOG entry will state, in the project's own published history, a property of a gate that the project deliberately changed.

## Scope

- The other three pending changesets naming that file were read in the same pass and are **still accurate** — so this is one sentence, ⛔ not a class.
- ⛔ Nothing about objectui#7265's slices falsified it: it was already false before this shift's slices landed.
